summary: Portal validation exposed setup mistakes and excessive vertical spacing
expected: Run package checks inside web/portal; use installed MUI exports and supported styling props; prioritize visible tickets.
actual: One npm test command ran at the worktree root and returned ENOENT. UI import used unavailable PersonOutline. After correcting it, 9 tests passed but tsc rejected removed direct system props. User browser feedback said header had too much whitespace and was too vertical.
correction: Run npm inside web/portal; verified PersonOutlined export; moved style props to sx and build passed. Compact title, fixture label and counts into one row; shorten fixture notice, tighten controls/cards and remove artificial lane minimum height. Repeat checks and browser inspection.
evidence: Initial UI stub: 6 expected behavior failures. First implemented UI run: unresolved import. Corrected import: 9 tests passed. Supported styling change: npm run build passed. User feedback captured during browser QA.
